crossRefs.note: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.
even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.
God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.
God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.
While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not…
I form the light and create darkness. I make peace and create calamity. I am Yahweh, who does all these things.
Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment…

translations.web: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.
translations.bsb: You bring darkness, and it becomes night, when all the beasts of the forest prowl.
translations.kjv: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep
translations.asv: Thou makest darkness, and it is night, Wherein all the beasts of the forest creep forth.
